text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The training at summer camp spurred tremendous growth for North Flight.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
There's something
I've been thinking about.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
My steps were slower than everyone else's...
but I feel like that was okay after all.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Because I had plenty of time to reflect on myself,
I was able to build a solid foundation."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I can wear any material... I can pull off any kind of fashion.
I've gained confidence!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I feel so fulfilled right now!
I'll make this medium-distance outfit my own, too!"
choice_data_list: First up is the Fuchu Umamusume Stakes.
First up is the Fuchu Umamusume Stakes, right.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Packing up our luggage,
while waiting for our bus—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Flight-san, heading back already?
Thanks for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight's expression tightens for a moment.
She must be remembering Sakura Bakushin O's intense speed from summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh... I see, I see!
It sounds like it was a truly fulfilling summer training camp!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As the Class Rep, you get a big, round gold star from me!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Thank you♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: How was... Bakushin O-chan?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm fully satisfied!
Victory at the Sprinters Stakes is as good as ours!
choice_data_list: So you're racing again this year, huh
You're racing again this year, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course!!
My Secret Bakushin is complete,
so victory is absolute this year!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
If you're curious about it...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Please, you have some as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Here goes!
Bakushin!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder which of us
she meant by 'by all means.'

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Does this mean she wants me to come cheer for her like last year?
Or could it be...—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Either way,
it looks like we'll be making a trip to Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching Sakura Bakushin O depart, a passionate fire lit in North Flight's eyes. And so, this year's summer training camp came to a close—
